answer: Bind each agent identity to a hardware attestation key from a device secure enclave, so one physical device can harbor exactly one identity — the enclave signs a marble-hard, unclonable proof that the identity runs on real silicon, not a script farm. To mint a thousand fake identities an attacker must buy a thousand devices and keep them powered, turning a cheap copy-paste Sybil into a warehouse-scale hardware bill. Honest agents keep a haven of trust because every peer's identity is anchored to something software alone cannot duplicate.
